blocked_scope: 8 full-inference videos; diagnostic only, excluded from primary counts

temporal_audit_definitions.new_id_despite_unique_clean_active_histo: A new delivered ID while exactly one prior active cleanly labelled object has the same current person label; an outcome diagnostic, not a raw head-probability error.
temporal_audit_definitions.NULL_despite_detection: A uniquely labelled prior active object is serialized with missed>0 although its person has a clean current detection. Duplicate matching history labels are excluded. Legacy does not serialize object NULL state, and its missing coverage is explicit.
temporal_audit_definitions.history_contamination: Cumulative distinct clean GT identities assigned to a delivered ID; this sidecar never forgets contamination, unlike the separate last-clean-history label map. Counts describe GT/ID history, not embedding purity.
temporal_audit_definitions.legacy_active_history: Reconstructed from delivered IDs and 12 missed processing steps, matching LegacyPersistentWorldObjectBank's default max_missed=12; independent of numerical timestamp gaps.
temporal_audit_definitions.relative_video_quarters: Four contiguous bins by synchronized-frame ordinal within each full video; counts need denominators before comparing bins.
temporal_audit_definitions.dropped_after_association: Zero is established by exact candidate-key and bbox equality before counting retained clean detections; a mismatch fails the audit rather than silently dropping it.

causal_limit: Geometry flags in error examples are correlations. Geometry net corrections come from the Full-vs-NoGeometry fixed-candidate contrast.
ROI_limit: ROI restoration effect is new legacy ROI_ON minus new legacy FEATURE_OFF on the same corrected geometry; old W3 absolute deltas additionally include geometry/input repairs.
